name: Private gift / external funding
description: Donations or privately funded building/grounds improvements reviewed under D-15
routing_rule: Any private money for a facility improvement; approver depends on project size
policy_citation: APS Policy D-15 External Funding (2025 draft text)

stages.name: Donor proposal to principal (2025 draft policy)
Review by Asst. Supt. F&O and Superintendent (2025 draft policy)
MOU (>= $15,000) or acceptance letter (< $15,000) (2025 draft policy)
stages.decider: School Board or Superintendent; principal for < $15,000

engage.how: Under the D-15 draft a private-funding proposal starts with the school. CCPTA guidance: confirm staff would welcome and can maintain it.
engage.ask: Would APS accept and maintain this improvement, what would it add to annual operating costs, and would other schools want the same feature?

engage.venue: Facilities and Operations review (projects under $15,000, 2025 draft policy)
engage.how: The 2025 draft makes projects under $15,000 reviewable by Facilities and Operations, with an acceptance letter rather than an MOU.
engage.ask: Does this project meet the three D-15 tests: benefit, no unplanned operating cost, no new inequity among schools?

engage.venue: School Board approval (projects of $100,001 or more, 2025 draft policy)
engage.when: School Board meeting; MOU required at $15,000 and above
engage.how: Larger privately funded improvements go to the Board. The equity test in D-15 asks whether other schools would want a similar feature.
engage.ask: If this school can fund it privately, what is the plan for schools that cannot?

sources.title: Proposed revisions to Policy D-15 External Funding-Commercial Activities (draft)
sources.notes: January 2025 first draft; adopted text not verified
